resolution: Candidate on top of Email31 that adopts the exact published Host141 Kit alpha.43 (released source 0b0c3bb194e6b166253d75e34e80d719ca8d5db8) for both App and Runtime and requires Host141 (schema 0.3.0-preview.135). App and Runtime sources changed after Email31, so Runtime28 is no longer byte-identical; the bundle, App and Runtime version numbers for this candidate are not yet assigned. The detached release manifest must resolve final source and public artifacts; this template does not claim CI, publication or live upgrade acceptance.

email.kit_compatibility: Host141 must be deployed before this App. Both consumers use the exact Host141 Kit alpha.43 release-flow bytes with app-owned domain modules. Kit43 raises the Experience worker source limit from 96 KiB to 112 KiB. Send keeps exact-message review; timing diagnostics never supply authority.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Latency acceptance requires measured current Host and Runtime callback, cached compose and sync-page results; a build alone does not establish those targets.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
